neutral_contract.meaning: Generic full-pipeline bounds distinguish 2700 critical-path candidate seconds from an outer 5400 occupied-candidate-second ceiling, with finite stage allocations inside them

definition: The original occupied_seconds_per_arm=5400 is the inherited generic outer occupied-work ceiling. It is not a second executable allocation, an extra locked recovery allowance, or an additional stage bound. It numerically equals the locked two-arm pair stage sum, but the handoff ceiling itself is per pipeline; do not silently rewrite the original field as a pair-total measurement.
operating_rule: Execute only the already-frozen stage requests under their exact existing operator/controller clocks, cleanup rules and role caps. The larger outer ceiling supplies no additional time, role, helper, duplicate Goal or recovery assignment. DEC007 continuation fits the scheduled remaining allowances; outside-allowance recovery remains separate lineage and cannot count as locked-arm completion.
reporting_rule: Report 2700 as the prescribed sum of stage allowances per arm and 5400 as the prescribed two-arm pair sum. If retaining the original per-arm 5400 field, label it inherited outer occupied-work ceiling, not provisioned stage allowance or observed cost. Measure actual wall/occupied candidate time, startup/service waits, interruptions, cleanup and all failed/recovery costs from receipts; neither budget scalar substitutes for observed cost, and overlapping time is not double-counted.
